en: Black‑and‑white streetscape showing a broad, slightly curving avenue lined with ornate late‑19th‑century brick and stone townhouses on the left. Ground floors contain shops and a clearly visible sign reading "HOTEL" above an arched entrance in one of the buildings. On the right stands a high wrought‑iron fence with stone gate pillars topped by round finials, enclosing a leafy garden and a large villa or institutional building with a tiled roof and decorative gables. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the pavements and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible further down the road. The street surface appears unpaved or only lightly paved, and there are telegraph poles along the road.
